description: Synthetic plans for building Preflight Briefs, one per class from R2 to R6 plus extra R2 and R4 cases. They cite claims from fixtures/ledger.jsonl. Round 4: every plan carries the mandatory four-question screen (money, deletion, outside, secret) with evidence. No real data.

plan.action: Change the Saturday weighting in the forecast brain rule from 1.0 to 1.1
plan.decision_by: 2026-10-09 18:00 America/Toronto, before the next Friday forecast run
plan.default_if_no_answer: Nothing changes; the current weighting stays.
plan.what_exactly: In the shared brain-rule file for the nightly forecast, change the Saturday weighting value from 1.0 to 1.1. No other rule changes. The change takes effect at the next nightly run.
plan.why: The backtest in claim C-fix-001 shows the current weighting under-forecasts Saturdays; the owner's correction is recorded in C-fix-002.
alternatives: Raise the weighting to 1.2 instead; rejected because the backtest error grows.
plan.blast_radius: Only the Saturday quantity in the nightly recommendation. The owner still approves every order.
plan.rollback: Restore the previous value 1.0 in the same file from version control. The Operations Manager does this in under five minutes. Test: run the forecast on a saved Saturday input and confirm it reproduces the old quantities.
plan.cost: No money. About two minutes of owner review.

money.evidence: no purchase, plan or price is involved; the cost section says no money

deletion.evidence: changes one value in a version-controlled file; the old value stays in version control and nothing is removed

outside.evidence: the change is inside the system and the owner still approves every order

secret.evidence: no key, token or password is involved; the no_secrets check scanned the diff

target_verified.note: the file path and key name exist

plan.action: Install the reviewed skill sample-notes into .claude/skills
plan.decision_by: 2026-10-12 12:00 America/Toronto, start of the research pass
plan.what_exactly: Copy the reviewed folder sample-notes, pinned to the recorded commit in the skill inventory, into .claude/skills/sample-notes. Nothing else is installed and no setting changes.
plan.why: Skill vetting found no failed checks (claim C-fix-002 records the source check) and the folder matches the pinned commit.
alternatives: Do nothing and keep doing the research by hand.
Use the skill from a sandbox copy only.
plan.blast_radius: Every session in this repository can load the skill. It has no scripts and no network access.
plan.rollback: Remove the folder .claude/skills/sample-notes in a new commit. The Librarian does this in about five minutes. Test: list the skills and confirm sample-notes no longer appears.
plan.cost: No money. No extra tokens beyond normal use.

money.evidence: the skill is a local folder with no paid service; the cost section says no money

deletion.evidence: copies a new folder in; nothing is removed or replaced

outside.evidence: the skill has no network access and nobody is told or contacted

secret.evidence: no key, token or password is involved; the skill has no scripts

target_verified.note: the commit hash matches the inventory

dry_run.note: a copy into a folder has no preview mode

rollback_tested.note: removal tested in a temp clone

plan.action: Delete the superseded draft files in the shared drafts folder
plan.what_exactly: Delete exactly three draft files that a newer version has replaced, listed by path in the attached dry-run listing. A dated backup copy is stored first.
plan.why: Claim C-fix-001 confirms the three files are exact duplicates of the newer versions.
alternatives: Do nothing and leave the clutter.
Move the files into an archive folder instead of deleting them.
plan.blast_radius: Three files nobody has opened since the newer versions replaced them.
plan.rollback: Copy the three files back from the dated backup folder. The Data Steward does this in about two minutes. Test: restore one file into a scratch folder and compare its checksum with the original.

money.evidence: no purchase, plan or price is involved; the cost section says no money

deletion.evidence: deletes exactly three draft files, with a dated backup copy stored first

outside.evidence: local files; nobody is told or contacted

secret.evidence: no key, token or password is involved

plan.action: Submit tonight's order in the supplier portal after the owner says yes
plan.default_if_no_answer: Nothing is submitted; the owner is pushed again at 19:40.
plan.what_exactly: Submit one order for the quantities in the approved recommendation, once, before the supplier cutoff. No other item is added.
plan.why: Claim C-fix-001 verifies the quantities and C-fix-002 verifies the cutoff time.
alternatives: Do nothing; the shop runs short tomorrow.
plan.blast_radius: One supplier order for tomorrow's stock; a wrong quantity means waste or a shortage.
plan.rollback: Change or cancel the order in the supplier portal before the cutoff. The owner does this in about three minutes. Test: confirm in the portal help page that an order can be edited before the cutoff.
plan.cost: The cost of the goods ordered, already inside the normal budget.

money.evidence: a goods order is an R4 order submission in the matrix, inside the normal budget, not a plan, tool or data cost beyond the allowance

deletion.evidence: adds one order; nothing is removed or replaced

outside.evidence: the order is submitted to the supplier, an outside party

secret.evidence: the owner is signed in to the portal; the agent never types or sees the password

target_verified.note: supplier and portal are the ones named in the terms

rollback_tested.note: edit option confirmed in the portal documentation

plan.action: Ask the owner to rotate the supplier portal password
plan.decision_by: 2026-10-20 12:00 America/Toronto, end of the security review
plan.default_if_no_answer: Nothing changes; the current password stays.
plan.what_exactly: The owner rotates the password on the supplier's own site and keeps the new one in the password manager. The agent writes the steps and never sees the value.
plan.why: The review in claim C-fix-002 recommends rotating shared credentials every year.
alternatives: Do nothing and rotate next year.
Turn on two-step sign-in instead of rotating.
plan.blast_radius: Only the owner's own access to the supplier portal.
plan.rollback: Use the supplier's password reset page to set another password. The owner does this in about five minutes. Test: confirm the reset page works by reading its help article before rotating.
plan.cost: No money. About ten minutes of owner time.

plan.action: Subscribe to a paid event-listings feed for the forecast
plan.decision_by: 2026-10-16 12:00 America/Toronto, end of the trial week
plan.what_exactly: Subscribe the shop's account to the feed for a one-month trial. The owner enters the payment details; the agent does not.
plan.why: Claim C-fix-001 shows the forecast misses event days; the free sources in C-fix-002 do not cover them.
alternatives: Do nothing and keep the free sources.
Check the city's free events page by hand each week.
plan.blast_radius: A monthly charge to the shop's card until the subscription ends.
plan.rollback: Cancel the subscription in the account page and ask for a refund of the last charge. The owner does this in about ten minutes. Test: read the cancellation terms and confirm that a cancel button exists before subscribing.
plan.cost: 20 CAD per month, 240 CAD per year, beyond the plan allowance. Justified only if forecast error on event days improves.
